name: 🥪 Open-Faced Pizza & Deli Melts
what: Thick toasted bread, sauce, meats and cheese under the broiler. Everyone builds their own.

core.name: Crusty bread
core.out: any bread, English muffins or naan

extras: ham, salami, parmesan, garlic powder, italian seasoning

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Broiler on high, rack near the top.
Slice the bread thick. Brush with oil and broil until just crisp.
Everyone builds their own: meats, mozzarella, a pinch of parmesan.
Broil until the cheese bubbles and browns. Don't walk away.

key: Toast the bread with oil before the toppings so it stays crisp.
done: The cheese bubbles with brown spots.
plan_b: No good bread? Same thing on tortillas for crispy tortilla pizzas.
